name: skating
label: Skating
description: The supplier's Skating skill for offensive forwards: an intercept plus a weighted sum of seven per-player event metrics, even strength in regulation, regular season.

source.fitted_on: 19 Rögle forwards, SHL 2026/27 (league 13): least squares on the portal's inputs and outputs, residual ~1e-14
source.valid_for: SHL 2026/27. Another league or season may carry other weights; re-fit before trusting a number there.

notes: Weights are per raw unit: a rate (0..1) and a count per 20 minutes live on different scales, so the weights cannot be compared with each other.
The supplier's even strength stops at the end of the third period: 3-on-3 overtime is out of both the events and the minutes. Counting it put Charles Hudon (893) at 0.476 against the portal's 0.404.
ce_scoring_chance is listed by the portal but has weight exactly 0.

Possession Driving Plays (supplier glossary): controlled entries, redline carries, controlled exits, completed north and east-west passes from the NZ, completed outlet and stretch passes from the DZ. Exits by pass are left out because they are the DZ outlet and stretch passes; counting both overshoots.
OZ LPRs leave out faceoff recoveries, which is why the LPR Faceoff group exists.
